body.purpose: Readable admin content, table values, and form labels.

headline.purpose: Page and section titles with clear scanning hierarchy.

shadows.name: panel-shadow
shadows.purpose: Focused authentication panel over the background image.

shadows.name: button-shadow
shadows.purpose: Subtle lift for primary actions where needed.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Compact hover and focus feedback on controls.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-priority action using the marketplace brand accent.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #ff385c; color: #fff; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; min-height: 46px; padding: 0 18px; font: 600 14px 'gg sans', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #B61F43; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff6682; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Dark Text Field
components.description: Compact, filled field for search and account forms.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 46px; box-sizing: border-box; background: #2C2F33; color: #fff; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1); border-radius: 6px; padding: 0 14px; font: 400 14px 'gg sans', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms ease, background 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #A1A1A5; } .ds-input:hover { background: #33363A; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #ff385c; } .ds-input:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(255,56,92,.25); }

components.name: Admin Panel
components.description: Flat charcoal surface grouped with a quiet boundary.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: #202024; color: #fff; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1); border-radius: 8px; padding: 24px; } .ds-panel h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; font: 600 16px 'gg sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-panel p { margin: 0; color: #A1A1A5; font: 400 14px/1.5 'gg sans', system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Small semantic indicator for workflow state.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 24px; padding: 0 9px; border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(53,237,126,.15); color: #35ED7E; font: 600 11px 'gg sans', system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: A focused, dark operations console for 4LIFE marketplace moderators and administrators. Neutral work surfaces keep attention on identity evidence, listings, and business data. Coral/berry provides a consistent marketplace accent; semantic colors stay attached to real system states. The intended component language is compact and flat, using tonal layers and fine borders for structure.
keyCharacteristics: Coral/berry brand emphasis used consistently and sparingly.
Flat components separated by surface tone and subtle borders.
Compact controls designed for repeated admin workflows.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Use coral/berry for brand emphasis; do not mix legacy purple into new screens.

rules.name: The Tonal Layer Rule
rules.body: Separate nested controls with a surface shift or border before adding another shadow.

dos: Do maintain high contrast between text and dark input or panel backgrounds.
Do use borders and tonal surface shifts to define component boundaries.
Do keep semantic colors tied to actual system states.
donts: Don't introduce Discord purple as a second brand accent in new screens.
Don't apply oversized pill radii to ordinary admin controls.
Don't rely on a prominent permanent outline for text fields.
